scope: Comment-only clarification of the already-tested liberal decoder policy; every non-comment source line is byte-identical.
patch:
--- Text.QuotedPrintable.before.cinch
+++ Text.QuotedPrintable.after.cinch
@@ -3,6 +3,8 @@
 -- Encoded lines contain at most 76 symbols, including a soft-break marker.
 -- Continuations snapshot unfinished input. Returned byte buffers are fresh and
 -- may be mutated without changing a continuation or another returned buffer.
+-- Decoding accepts lowercase hex, raw high bytes and malformed non-newline
+-- escapes as literals; precise errors retain the successfully decoded prefix.
 module Text.QuotedPrintable where
 
   import Algebra.Semigroup
@@ -531,7 +533,8 @@
       (consumed, state) -> case quoted-printable-decoder-finish state of
         (tail, error) -> (events-output (Cons (0, out) (Cons (0, tail) Nil)), error)
 
-  -- | Decode completely, returning a named failure when any input is malformed.
+  -- | Return fresh decoded bytes or the first failure under the decoder
+  -- acceptance rules. Lowercase hex and malformed non-newline escapes are accepted.
   -- Use decode-prefix when the successfully decoded bytes before an error matter.
   quoted-printable-decode-bytes :: Bytes -> Result QuotedPrintableError Bytes
   quoted-printable-decode-bytes input = case quoted-printable-decode-prefix input of
